title: Boiler Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Boiler Inspection: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Boiler Inspection Checklist covers boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop. The facility boiler coordinator records Boiler Inspection criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Boiler Inspection Checklist keeps Boiler Inspection exceptions visible until the facility boiler coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Boiler Inspection Checklist at boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system. Document boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop identity before Boiler Inspection begins. Compare boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop findings with stated Boiler Inspection criteria; route unresolved Boiler Inspection issues to qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer. For Boiler Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Boiler Inspection. Ask qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer to review Boiler Inspection conditions beyond the facility boiler coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Boiler Inspection, identify responsible parties, boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system, and the linked boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop source.

fields.label: Make, model, serial, rating, fuel, and permit reference
Operating schedule, service history, and inspection basis

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Boiler Inspection facts for boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Boiler Inspection checks
items: Visible vessel, piping, valve, pump, and leak condition
Burner, flame, fuel-train, and ignition observation
Vent, draft, combustion-air, and room condition
Pressure, temperature, level, and makeup-water indication
Limit, cutoff, relief, alarm, and control response
Startup, operating, shutdown, and lockout sequence

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Boiler Inspection evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Facility Boiler Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Low-water, limit, relief, or cutoff failure
Unsafe pressure, temperature, venting, or vessel condition
Test requires authority or shutdown not available
Combustion or operating readings by instrument
blocks.guidance: Pause Boiler Inspection when a fuel, combustion, pressure-boundary, venting, or required safety-control concern remains. Retain the available Boiler Inspection proof and route unresolved boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop scope to facility boiler coordinator.
